coverLetter: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer position at LGG Advisors. With 7+ years of experience architecting scalable applications for enterprise clients across the US and Europe, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your innovative financial sector consultancy.

My expertise aligns closely with your requirements: I have extensive experience with TypeScript, Vue.js, React, and Angular on the frontend, combined with strong backend skills in Node.js and Laravel. At Delfín Motor Labs, I architect Vue 3/Nuxt applications with TypeScript while implementing CI/CD pipelines that reduced deployment failures by 62%. At BSE America, I built a full-stack CRM system with automated financial workflows and established code review standards while mentoring developers—directly matching your emphasis on code quality and peer mentoring.

Working with First Due (an Inc 5000 company), I developed multi-tenant SaaS platforms for 40+ enterprise clients using Agile methodologies with distributed US teams. This experience has given me deep familiarity with Jira, Git workflows, and cross-functional collaboration across time zones. I am well-versed in secure coding principles, database optimization (PostgreSQL/MySQL), and implementing SDLC best practices with automated testing and CI/CD.

I am particularly drawn to LGG Advisors because of your focus on sophisticated financial sector clients and your commitment to innovation. The opportunity to work from your Porto or Lisbon office with visa sponsorship and relocation support is exactly what I am seeking for my next career chapter. I thrive in environments that balance technical excellence with creative problem-solving for complex client needs.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my full-stack expertise, experience with distributed teams, and passion for clean, secure code can contribute to LGG Advisors' continued growth.
Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to connecting.
